Cuban percussionist Luis Conte came to the United States in 1967 and has become an in-demand session musician as well as a touring artist with James Taylor, Phil Collins, and other iconic headliners. For many decades he has made his home in Los Angeles.
Luis was interviewed via Zoom on November 24, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have Luis Conte with me this afternoon – afternoon for me and you’re on the other coast, so thanks to technology we can sort of have a virtual handshake. Thank you for being here.
